P1_nw8.cause: numRegs < vec: Thread owns 4 elems (8B), so compiler emits LDS/STS.64 (2 wf/inst). Model used vec=8 (16B, 4 wf/inst), overpredicting wf by 2x.

P3_fp32_vec1.cause: Blocked layout sizePerThread allows 128-bit LDS/STS.128 (vec=4, 16B). Model used vec=1 (4B scalar), predicting 32-lane scalar conflicts instead of 8-lane conflict-free quarter-warps.

P4_fp32_vec1.cause: Same as P3: blocked layout emits LDS/STS.128 (vec=4), conflict-free. Model used vec=1, predicting 96/192 conflicts.

P5_32x64_linear.cause: Unswizzled linear layout enabled LLVM to emit LDS.128 (16B, vec=16) instead of vec=8 (8B), halving instruction count.
